I honestly don't know how Catcher in the Rye ends. I couldn't finish it. It somewhat impacted my English grade since we were reading it for school. But couldn't make myself read anymore. It's been a long time but I recall the struggle between not wanting to be a straight laced phony/not wanting to buy into dry meaningless adult life and coming to the understanding that being a rebel and a degenerate also came with adult problems and was equally meaningless.

...The kind of things you only learn by experience anyway.
